123:t_1:83.en:
$$スズネ$$
「In this battle... I have a feeling the anxiety I've felt all this time will take on a concrete form...」

123:t_2:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(I've breached the security...! First, I'll extract as much data as possible into the $$ラファエル$$!)

123:t_2:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(So $$サイデリアル$$ really did invade Earth for its $$次元力|lc$$...)

123:t_2:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(But what do they intend to do with that $$次元力|lc$$...? If I knew that, their next moves would...)

123:t_2:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(What is their top-priority strategic objective...?)

123:t_2:7.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(This is... about the $$スフィア$$...)

123:t_3:3.en: ～$$ネェル・アーガマ$$　Briefing Room～

123:t_3:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「...I see. So the $$黒の騎士団$$ and the $$プリベンター$$ were defeated in $$新日本$$ by that $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$ too...」

123:t_3:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「His cunning strategy broke $$新日本$$'s very will to fight.」

123:t_3:6.en:
$$スザク$$
「In the end, we lost the decisive battle in $$トウキョウ$$ and escaped the country with support from General $$藤堂$$ and the others.」

123:t_3:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「His very existence is deadly poison. If we let a bastard like him run wild, he'll tear the world apart.」

123:t_3:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Just as $$ガドライト#pilot$$ amplifies the conflicting emotions deep within people, $$バルビエル$$ has the power to amplify hatred in their hearts.」

123:t_3:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So that's the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$ $$スフィア$$...」

123:t_3:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Because of that man, the volunteer army, which included civilians, collapsed from within. $$新日本$$ lost its spiritual backbone and was defeated.」

123:t_3:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It was all my failure as commander...」

123:t_3:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But I... used $$ギアス$$ to stop the people whose hatred he had amplified...」

123:t_3:15.en:
$$オットー$$
(According to the records, since the 《$$ゼロ・レクイエム$$》, $$ゼロ$$ had never used 《$$ギアス$$》...)

123:t_3:16.en:
$$オットー$$
(Captain $$アムロ$$ told me it was his way of drawing a line under the past he regretted...)

123:t_3:18.en:
$$オットー$$
(Like $$フル・フロンタル$$, $$ゼロ$$ wears a mask to turn himself into a symbol...)

123:t_3:19.en:
$$オットー$$
(But it represents a vow, almost a curse, to give up his own life and fight for the people...)

123:t_3:20.en:
$$オットー$$
(He must have been bitterly frustrated at having to break one part of that vow by using his sealed-away $$ギアス$$...)

123:t_3:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「You needn't say anything, $$ゼロ$$. Your frustration is shared by all of us who suffered defeat too.」

123:t_3:23.en:
$$オットー$$
「We will defeat that man ourselves, without fail...!」

123:t_3:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... He's a new $$スフィア・リアクター$$...」

123:t_3:26.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Like 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》, he commands his own unit. He also appears to hold an important position within the Empire.」

123:t_3:27.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$新日本$$ has fallen, and the North American front will suffer a major setback after our failure to take $$セントラル・ベース$$...」

123:t_3:29.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「We've detected $$サイデリアル$$ approaching! Captain, come to the bridge at once!」

123:t_3:30.en:
$$オットー$$
「You all heard that! It seems they have no intention of letting us escape!」

123:t_3:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They've targeted us instead of focusing on the war against the Federation forces in North America...!」

123:t_3:32.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What's... going to happen to us...?」

123:t_3:33.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's not what'll happen to us...! It's what we're going to do!」

123:t_3:35.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If they want to fight, we'll face them! If they target a single unit, their warped strategy will eventually bring about their own destruction!」

123:t_3:37.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We will never yield. We will survive and continue our resistance.」

123:t_3:38.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, prepare to launch...! Hurry!」

123:t_3:41.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$n... Before you go, there's something I must tell you.」

123:t_3:43.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「When I gathered information about the Empire at $$セントラル・ベース$$, seizing $$スフィア$$s was listed as a key part of its strategy.」

123:t_3:45.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Be careful, $n. In the battles ahead, the Empire will be after your $$スフィア$$.」

123:t_3:47.en:
$n
「The $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$ $$スフィア・リアクター$$... And my $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$...」

123:t_3:48.en:
$n
「Is this... the real source of the anxiety I've felt...?」

123:t_10:4.en:
$n
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. $$サイデリアル$$ is coming. Whatever it is, save it for later.」

123:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...You seem concerned about what $$ティエリア$$ said.」

123:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But that $$バルビエル$$ seems to feel the same way. He showed quite an interest in the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$.」

123:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s generated when you fought that man, $n... I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

123:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A battle over $$スフィア$$s... I'm sure it will generate many $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

123:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And when they're all gathered... That will be the time for our true battle, yours, and theirs, $n...」

123:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It seems you're all busy intercepting $$サイデリアル$$.」

123:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll help too, as a dimensional merchant... I'll provide the $$サーペント$$s I stocked up on free of charge.」

123:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business today too! So let's get fired up... Business, business!」

123:t_10:18.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're right. When I sharpen my senses, I can feel something like that.」

123:t_10:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I need a little more time to gather my thoughts.」

123:t_10:23.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're unusually hesitant. But I have no choice but to leave this to you.」

123:t_10:24.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「The dimensional merchant, $$ＡＧ$$... If that man holds the answer to your question...」

123:t_10:25.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Uncovering his true identity will have a major bearing on this world's future...」

124:t_000:1.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The Federation forces have begun fighting in the surrounding area too.」

124:t_000:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「That's good...! While they're doing that, we'll take $$セントラル・ベース$$!」

124:t_000:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Everyone, review the operation once more!」
